threat_summary: A threat advisory reports malware using high-volume DNS TXT queries with encoded-looking subdomains for command and data transfer.
key_behaviors: many TXT queries to same base domain
hunt_checklist: Find hosts with high TXT query count.
Search for long or high-entropy subdomains.
Group by host and base domain.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when one host generates abnormal TXT volume to unknown domains and endpoint context is missing or suspicious.
analyst_notes: Generated as synthetic gold output for MVP evaluation. Queries should be reviewed against the real SIEM/EDR schema.
